questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 In a given software, which of the following represents high cohesion and high coupling?
options: The functions in each module perform various functions, and a lot of data is interchanged or shared between the modules.
The functions in each module perform a specific function, and a lot of data is interchanged or shared between the modules.
The functions in each module are performing various functions, and no or very little data is interchanged or shared between the modules.
The functions in each module are performing specific functions, and no or very little data is interchanged or shared between the modules.
